title: ModulePackageService
responsibility: Plan pinned dependency declarations without installing packages.

inputs.name: ModulePackageService.plan.name
inputs.description: Registry package with an exact semantic version, including an optional scope.

outputs.name: ModulePackageService.plan
outputs.description: A package.json write plan preserving unrelated settings.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Invalid package pins, conflicting existing versions or unreadable manifests reject the plan.
